purpose: A bounded 14-day launch queue within a 30-day zero-ad-spend organic relaunch experiment.
authority_note: This artifact prepares exact copy. The root task owns account access, current authority, independent review, publication, scheduling and canonical integration. A calendar date or LOCAL_DRAFT row is not proof of external execution.

launch.relative_day_definition: Day 1 is the local America/New_York calendar date of the first new, successfully published and independently read-back relaunch post. Later dates are launch_date plus relative_day minus one.
launch.calendar_rule: One original post maximum per planned day. Do not backfill missed days or compress the queue. Dates are proposed until the root records a real launch and any actual schedule receipt.

resource_caps.post_frequency: 3-4 originals per week; reduce when necessary to protect the time ceiling.

link_convention.utm_content_rule: Stable unique value for each linked piece; never reused for a substantively different replacement.
link_convention.unlinked_post_url_rule: exact_url=null means intentionally no outbound link; do not append a generic shop link.

character_check.method: All prepared bodies use ASCII. Estimated count is body.length plus 1 newline plus 23 for a single URL, or body.length for no URL. Native composer is the final check.

global_required_preflight: Root holds the exact X claim and fresh account readback identifies @dresslikemommy; stop for a different account, login, CAPTCHA or account-switch requirement.
Reconcile the current execution receipts and live profile for this immutable post ID, UTM content and candidate copy; never repost an already executed or ambiguously executed row.
Independent reviewer checks exact copy and any actual media for truthful category, sizing, included-piece, price, timing and rights claims.
For a linked row, open the destination as needed, verify current relevant content and the exact four UTM values through redirects; record every tagged operator QA visit with UTC time.
Preserve existing article and Pinterest release clocks; create the X launch clock only from a real publication receipt.
Inspect final native composer account, exact text, count, URL preview, media crop and alt text. Text-only publication is valid when optional media is absent.
Publish once only after current authorization and preflight agree. If the response is uncertain, inspect the profile before any retry.
Read back the exact public post URL, platform ID, visible text, destination and media; record UTC time and actual pin state separately. Do not infer success from composer disappearance.
No ads, boost, subscriptions, billing, security changes, purchases, mass DMs, fabricated interaction or writes to other channels are part of this queue.

qa_exclusion.rule: Exclude prepublication QA from the X release cohort. Record later tagged QA timestamps and exclude identifiable operator visits using available read-only reporting; if exact isolation is unavailable, label affected figures mixed or unknown instead of subtracting an invented count.

measurement.order_confirmation: Distinct paid, noncancelled Shopify orders with available X journey evidence, reconciled for reversals; final contribution may remain provisional while costs or return outcomes are missing.
measurement.diagnostic_limit: Post views, likes and follows are not orders, unique buyers or incremental sales.

posts.body: The outfit check before photo day: sit, walk, raise your arms, and try the shoes with the whole look. For children, leave time to change anything they don't feel comfortable wearing. A short try-on can surface a problem early.

preflight_extra: Preserve this as a suggested try-on routine, not a promise of comfort, fit, delivery or returns.
